setup.title: How to populate / refresh friends.db
setup.intro: Each step runs a real script. Step 1 opens a real browser: log in normally (2FA included), then click "I'm logged in".
setup.step1.title: Log in to Spectrum
setup.step1.desc: Opens a window where you log into your RSI account, just like a normal browser (credentials + 2FA).
setup.step2.title: Fetch your friends list
setup.step2.desc: Downloads your complete friends list from Spectrum.
setup.step3.title: Load into the app
setup.step3.desc: Adds that list into the app so you can sort it and decide who to keep.
setup.emptyBanner: 👋 Welcome! Start with the 3 steps below to load your friends.
setup.autoRefresh.label: Auto-refresh (periodically fetches + imports)
setup.profiles.intro: ⚠ Fetches enlistment date and affiliate orgs from each friend's public RSI profile page — two things missing from the friends list itself. Deliberately very slow (5 friends every ~3 min): for everyone, this can take several hours. Leave the field empty to process everyone, or set a number to test on a small batch.
danger.title: ⚠ Real deletion on Spectrum
danger.confirmLabel: Type YES in capitals to enable the button:
apply.busyBanner: ⏳ Deletion in progress on Spectrum — decisions, notes, and bulk actions are locked until it finishes. Don't close this window.
footer.text: Decisions are local. Only the red button triggers real calls to Spectrum.
confirmBulk: Mark ALL currently filtered results ({count}) as "{label}"?
dangerDesc: Really removes, on the site, every friend marked "Remove" and not yet applied ({n}). Irreversible on the friend's side. Drives a real browser clicking the Unfriend button, with a pause between each removal.
lastConfirm: Final confirmation: really run the deletion on Spectrum?
